title: Copilot in your Microsoft 365 work quiz

questions.question: What does broader work grounding through Microsoft Graph mean?

answers.text: Copilot can use relevant work content the user already has permission to access.
answers.feedback: Grounding does not grant new permissions.

answers.text: Copilot gives every employee access to every file.
Any grounded answer is guaranteed correct.
answers.feedback: Sources can be old or the answer can be wrong.

questions.feedback: Grounding does not grant new permissions.

questions.question: What is accurate about included Copilot Chat in a supported Outlook experience?

answers.text: It can never use any work content.
answers.feedback: Current supported Outlook experiences have bounded organisational grounding.

answers.text: It can use inbox, calendar and limited related data; the add-on reaches further.
answers.feedback: The scope differs by experience and licence.

answers.text: It replaces the need to check replies.
answers.feedback: Check current source facts, recipients and commitments.

questions.feedback: The scope differs by experience and licence.

questions.question: Which checks help with the Word and Excel exercises? Select all that apply.

answers.text: Check each Word checklist step against the supplied notes.
answers.feedback: A useful draft preserves source responsibilities.

answers.text: Use a separate Excel practice file and check the source cells.
answers.feedback: Keep live work safe and verify the numbers.

answers.text: Treat a tidy chart as proof that the data range is right.
Choose Chat only for the Excel exercise if that mode is available.

questions.feedback: A useful draft preserves source responsibilities. Keep live work safe and verify the numbers. It keeps the response in the pane instead of editing the workbook.

questions.question: After a Teams meeting, what is needed to ask Copilot about what was spoken?

answers.text: An available transcript, plus the supported licence and meeting setup.
answers.feedback: Post-meeting questions about speech need an available transcript.

answers.text: Only an invitation, even if nothing was transcribed.
answers.feedback: The invitation is not evidence of what was said.
That is unrelated to Teams meeting grounding.

questions.feedback: Post-meeting questions about speech need an available transcript.
